notes: Library title typing now performs live fuzzy matching against manifest-index titles, tolerating punctuation, articles and common edition/media wording.
UPC scans first check both manifest-indexed media and owned_upcs; existing ownership opens immediately without external metadata lookup.
Only completely new UPCs automatically reuse Rip Manager's existing multi-provider disc-input UPC lookup, then feed the detected title into the same fuzzy title matcher.
Choosing a suggested title is the single association click for a new UPC; owned_upcs now retains that resolved title so later scans open it immediately.
